name: SmartHR
summary: SmartHR and products that follow its design system: creating is 追加 and saving an edit is 更新, the result of an operation shows beside the control that ran it and stays, and a progress indicator waits one second.

evidence.source: SmartHR Design System, 操作を表す用語
evidence.says: The creating operation is 追加 by default; saving edited data is 更新; キャンセル stops an operation that has not run yet, and 取り消し one that has.

evidence.source: SmartHR Design System, フィードバック
evidence.says: The result of a synchronous process shows near the button the user operated last, as a ResponseMessage in the success or the error state; an input error shows on the input when the focus leaves it.
A notification bar is hidden by an explicit action of the user; closing it after a time is discouraged.
The loader is left out where loading ends in under one second, since the flicker harms the experience.
A required input carries the label 必須, and an optional one may carry 任意.
